sql-set.sql: SELECT "Id", "Code", "SKU", "Name", "DisplayName", "ShortName", "Description", "ProductType", "BaseCost", "BasePrice", "Currency", "ProductOwnerId", "ProductOwner", "ProductCode", "ProductActive", "SalesStartDate", "SalesEndDate", "SupportStartDate", "SupportEndDate", "VendorId", "VendorName", "ProductCategoryId", "ProductCategory", "ManufacturerId", "Manufacturer", "UnitPrice", "CommissionRate", "TaxId", "Tax", "UsageUnitId", "UsageUnit", "QuantityInStock", "HandlerId", "Handler", "QuantityOrdered", "ReorderLevel", "QuantityInDemand", "CreatedBy", "CreatedDateTime", "UpdatedBy", "UpdatedDateTime", "CustomFields" AS "CustomFieldJson" FROM "AcmeProduct" WHERE "Id" = @Id AND "IsDeleted" = FALSE order by "UpdatedDateTime" Desc;

SELECT "Id", "Code", "SKU", "Name", "DisplayName", "ShortName", "Description", "ProductType", "BaseCost", "BasePrice", "Currency", "ProductOwnerId", "ProductOwner", "ProductCode", "ProductActive", "SalesStartDate", "SalesEndDate", "SupportStartDate", "SupportEndDate", "VendorId", "VendorName", "ProductCategoryId", "ProductCategory", "ManufacturerId", "Manufacturer", "UnitPrice", "CommissionRate", "TaxId", "Tax", "UsageUnitId", "UsageUnit", "QuantityInStock", "HandlerId", "Handler", "QuantityOrdered", "ReorderLevel", "QuantityInDemand", "CreatedBy", "CreatedDateTime", "UpdatedBy", "UpdatedDateTime", "CustomFields" AS "CustomFieldJson" FROM "AcmeProduct" WHERE "IsDeleted" = FALSE order by "UpdatedDateTime" Desc;
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "AcmeProduct" WHERE "Name" = @Name AND "IsActive" = TRUE AND "IsDeleted" = FALSE );
SELECT "Code" FROM "AcmeProduct" ORDER BY "CreatedDateTime" DESC LIMIT 1;
